verdict.rationale: While BILL has extensive API documentation and even an MCP server for AI tools to query docs (bill-spend-expense-docs-18), there is no evidence of a downloadable machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec. A direct probe of standard OpenAPI spec locations (openapi.json, swagger.json, etc.) returned 404 on all paths, and the llms.txt only points to prose documentation, not a machine-readable API schema.
